name: Menu Assist — AI-Powered Dietary Intelligence App

scripts.build: pnpm run build:gateway && pnpm run build:application && pnpm run build:auth && pnpm run build:admin && pnpm run build:ai
scripts.build:application: pnpm run build:api-auth && pnpm run build:ai-pipeline && pnpm run prisma:generate:application && nest build application-service
scripts.build:admin: pnpm run build:api-auth && pnpm run build:file-storage && nest build admin-service
scripts.build:ai: pnpm run build:api-auth && pnpm run build:ai-pipeline && pnpm run prisma:generate:ai && nest build ai-ingestion-service
scripts.start:dev:application: pnpm run build:api-auth && pnpm run build:ai-pipeline && pnpm run prisma:generate:application && nest start application-service --watch
scripts.start:dev:admin: pnpm run build:api-auth && nest start admin-service --watch
scripts.start:dev:ai: pnpm run build:api-auth && pnpm run build:ai-pipeline && pnpm run prisma:generate:ai && nest start ai-ingestion-service --watch
scripts.prisma:generate:auth: prisma generate --schema apps/auth-service/prisma/schema.prisma && node scripts/patch-prisma-client-cjs.mjs apps/auth-service
scripts.prisma:generate:admin: prisma generate --schema apps/admin-service/prisma/schema.prisma && node scripts/patch-prisma-client-cjs.mjs apps/admin-service
scripts.prisma:generate:all: npm run prisma:generate:application && npm run prisma:generate:auth && npm run prisma:generate:admin && npm run prisma:generate:ai
scripts.prisma:migrate:auth: pnpm --dir apps/auth-service exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:migrate:admin: pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --config apps/admin-service/prisma.config.ts
scripts.prisma:migrate:application: pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy --config apps/application-service/prisma.config.ts
scripts.backfill:stored-files: pnpm run prisma:generate:admin && pnpm run build:admin && node dist/apps/admin-service/apps/admin-service/src/backfill-stored-files.js
scripts.seed:all: pnpm run seed:auth && pnpm run seed:admin
scripts.push:all: git push origin main && git push backup main
scripts.pull:all: git pull origin main && git pull backup main
